title: Hats Renewed
description: Hats adds in more than 430+ collectible hats & accessories for players to unlock!
body:
## Hats Renewed
Hats Renewed adds in more than 430+ collectible hats & accessories for players to unlock. Featuring rarity tiers, customizable colors, and unlockable accessories for you to tweak & change your hats to your liking.
**How to unlock hats:** Hats are wearable cosmetics that can appear on mobs and be collected by players. When mobs spawn, a percentage of them are randomly assigned a hat, kill these mobs & collect their hats. **How to equip/check your hats:** By default, you can access the Hats GUI by pressing the "H" key on your keyboard.
## ✨ Features - **Customization** - Customize colors and visual properties! - **Accessories** - Unlock & Browse countless accessories that make your hat yours! - **Legacy Parity** - Experience all legacy hats & accesories from the original Hats mod! - **Trading** - Fully interactible UI for trading your hats with your friends! - **Hat Launcher ** - Give your hats to your favorite mobs, or launch your hats away! - **New Hats** - Find & Collect completely new hats with a whole new look!
## 📷 Media
## 📥 Installation **Client & Server Required !** **Forge/Neoforge requires:** - [Architectury API](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/architectury-api) **Fabric requires:** - [Architectury API](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/architectury-api) - [Forge Config API Port](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/forge-config-api-port) - [Fabric API](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/fabric-api)
## ⚙️ Configuration Most options can be changed through editting the config file in `.minecraft/config/hats.toml` directly, you should be able to tweak the mod to your liking there, as well as change the rate in which mobs spawn with hats. > 💡 **Tip:** edits made to the config file apply the next time you load a world.
## ❤️ Credits Ported & Maintained with care by **Antikythera Studios**. This is the 1.20+ port of Hats, originally made by iChun for Forge 1.6.2-1.16.5. The original project is licensed under LGPL. Development of the original mod stopped in 2023, and this version continues the project for modern versions of the game, with support for Forge, NeoForge, and Fabric in 1.20+. This version isn't a 1:1 port of the old mod, i've taken the core idea of the mod, and re-made it in a way that's easier to maintain & create on top of. Some of the ideas like Hat Trading were also implemented into this port & i've removed some things that i deemed unecessary like the point system. Credit goes to [iChun](https://www.curseforge.com/members/ichun/projects) for the original concept and implementation. If you enjoy this mod, consider supporting his other work ❤️. - **Code & New Hats** - the Antikythera Studios team - **Legacy Hats** - iChun & Contributors Enjoying the mod? A ⭐ on the repo and recommending the mod on Modrinth / CurseForge helps more than you'd think.
